caption: Annual critical share within each prefilter genre, 2021-2025.
notes: Critical share computed separately within discourse and evaluative records. 95% percentile bootstrap CIs (1000 resamples, deterministic seed 42 + cell index per genre-year cell, cells ordered by genre then year); point estimates are unchanged from the submitted Table S3. Discourse: Spearman ρ ρ=+0.90 (P=.083); OR 1.061 per year (95% CI 1.015-1.108), P=.008. Evaluative: Spearman ρ ρ=+0.80 (P=.133); OR 1.209 per year (95% CI 1.144-1.277), P<.001. Annual series are plotted in {{F:within_genre_fig}}. Critical stance was Alarm or Caution.

Version 2 (Batch 2d): every OR per year here comes from record-level logistic regression on publication year with journal cluster-robust SEs (95% CI and P from the cluster-robust covariance); point estimates are unchanged.
